spectators.label: Noodle seller
spectators.look: stocky cheerful cook with a round face, a thin black mustache and a twisted white towel headband, wearing a white cook's jacket with rolled sleeves and a long navy apron, carrying a wooden tray with a steaming bowl of noodles and chopsticks
spectators.idle: balancing the tray, craning to see the ring
spectators.cheer: tray raised high in one hand, other fist up
spectators.shocked: noodles flying out of the bowl, eyes wide

spectators.label: Popcorn vendor
spectators.look: skinny freckled young man with a red-and-white striped vest, a white paper boat hat and a bow tie, carrying a neck-strap tray stacked with red-striped paper cones of popcorn
spectators.idle: holding out a cone of popcorn to a customer, eyes on the ring
spectators.cheer: tossing popcorn in the air, cheering
spectators.shocked: popcorn exploding out of the tray, paper hat flying

spectators.label: TV cameraman
spectators.look: burly cameraman with a backwards black cap, a short beard and a headset with a mic, wearing a black t-shirt under a khaki many-pocket vest and cargo pants, a big shoulder-mounted broadcast camera with a red tally light
spectators.idle: filming the ring with the camera on his shoulder
spectators.cheer: camera steadied with one hand, other arm out to the side, whooping
spectators.shocked: camera tilting off his shoulder, mouth open under the headset

spectators.label: Huge security guard
spectators.look: massive broad-shouldered security guard with a flat-top haircut, dark sunglasses, a coiled earpiece and a stone face, wearing a navy uniform shirt with a plain yellow armband, black trousers and a black belt with a flashlight
spectators.cheer: arms out to the sides, a rare grin cracking his face

spectators.label: Sleepy janitor with a mop
spectators.look: lanky middle-aged janitor with a long face, sleepy droopy eyes and a grey stubble, wearing a grey cap and grey work overalls with a rag in the back pocket, holding a mop next to a yellow bucket on wheels
spectators.idle: leaning on the mop handle, watching the fight
spectators.cheer: mop raised high like a flag

spectators.label: Drink-tank vendor girl
spectators.look: energetic young woman with a short orange bob and a green sun visor, wearing a green-and-white uniform polo and shorts, carrying a silver drink tank on her back with a hose nozzle and a stack of paper cups
spectators.idle: filling a cup from the hose, glancing at the ring
spectators.cheer: spraying a little arc of drink in the air, laughing

spectators.label: Steamed-bun vendor auntie
spectators.look: small round auntie with her hair tucked in a white hairnet and flour on her cheek, wearing a pink apron over a white blouse with rolled sleeves, carrying a stack of round bamboo steamer baskets
spectators.idle: lifting a steamer lid, steam rising
spectators.cheer: holding up a fluffy white bun, cheering

spectators.label: Press photographer
spectators.look: sharp-eyed reporter woman with short wavy brown hair and a pencil tucked behind one ear, wearing a beige safari vest over a white shirt and brown slacks, holding an old-fashioned press camera with a big round flash dish
spectators.idle: camera raised, lining up a shot
spectators.shocked: camera lowered, pencil fallen, mouth open

spectators.label: Usher in a pillbox hat
spectators.look: thin young usher with slicked black hair and a polite smile, wearing a burgundy uniform jacket with gold piping and buttons, a small burgundy pillbox hat with a chin strap and white gloves, holding a flashlight
spectators.idle: standing at attention, flashlight pointed at the floor
spectators.shocked: pillbox hat popping up off his head

spectators.label: Tournament medic
spectators.look: calm young medic with a short black ponytail and a surgical mask pulled down to her chin, wearing a white medical coat over light-green scrubs and white sneakers, carrying a white first-aid case
spectators.idle: first-aid case at her side, watching for injuries
spectators.shocked: rushing forward with the case, eyes wide

spectators.label: Ring repair worker
spectators.look: big friendly construction worker with a yellow hard hat, a bushy brown mustache and sunburned arms, wearing a sleeveless orange work vest over a navy tee, a tool belt and work boots, holding a big hammer and a white stone tile
spectators.idle: resting the hammer on his shoulder, sighing at the cracked ring
spectators.cheer: hammer held out to the side, other arm out, cheering
spectators.shocked: stone tile dropped, hard hat tipped back

spectators.label: Balloon seller
spectators.look: round little man with a black bowler hat, a curly black mustache and rosy cheeks, wearing a red-and-yellow checkered vest over a white shirt with sleeve garters, a bunch of colorful balloons tied to his wrist bobbing at shoulder height
spectators.idle: holding the balloon strings, smiling at the ring
spectators.cheer: balloon bunch bouncing, other hand waving
spectators.shocked: one balloon popping, hat jumping off his head

spectators.label: Bento delivery boy
spectators.look: hurried teenage delivery boy with spiky brown hair under a blue cap and a sweatband, wearing a blue delivery uniform jacket with white stripes on the sleeves and blue shorts, balancing a stack of cloth-wrapped bento boxes on one shoulder
spectators.idle: bento stack on his shoulder, distracted by the fight
spectators.cheer: free fist pumped up, bento stack wobbling

spectators.label: Souvenir hawker
spectators.look: wiry woman with a wide straw sun hat and a loud grin, wearing a many-pocket green apron over a striped shirt, carrying a tray of small red pennant flags and shiny orange glass orbs
spectators.idle: holding up a pennant to sell, eyeing the ring
spectators.shocked: orange orbs rolling off the tray

spectators.label: Boom-mic operator
spectators.look: laid-back sound technician with a long black ponytail, a chin-strap beard and big over-ear headphones, wearing an all-black outfit with a utility belt, holding a long boom pole with a fuzzy grey microphone held low and diagonal
spectators.idle: pole angled toward the ring, listening intently
spectators.cheer: headphones pressed tight, pole raised diagonally, grinning
spectators.shocked: wincing at the noise, headphones pushed off
